question: A large plant has several UV reactors in parallel. What does duty and standby capacity mean in this setting?

options: All reactors run at full power at all times
Reactor lamps are stored in a separate building
Flow is sent around the reactors at night
Spare reactors cover cleaning, faults and peak flow
